column1: decide|/dɪˈsaɪd/|v.|决定；判断|基础|decide|decide to::决定做;decide on::选定|We need to decide on a date for the visit.::我们需要选定参观日期。|She decided to walk home instead.::她决定改为步行回家。

decision|/dɪˈsɪʒən/|n.|决定；决策|基础|decide|make a decision::作决定;a final decision::最终决定|We cannot make a decision without enough information.::没有足够的信息，我们无法作决定。|The final decision will be announced tomorrow.::最终决定将于明天公布。
choose|/tʃuːz/|v.|选择；挑选|基础|choose|choose from::从……中选择;choose to::选择做|You can choose from three different routes.::你可以从三条不同路线中选择。|She chose to explain the problem in person.::她选择亲自解释这个问题。
choice|/tʃɔɪs/|n.|选择；选项；选择权|基础|choose|make a choice::作出选择;have no choice::别无选择|The menu offers a choice of fresh vegetables.::菜单提供多种新鲜蔬菜供选择。|We had no choice but to wait.::我们别无选择，只能等待。
prefer|/prɪˈfɜːr/|v.|更喜欢；宁愿|基础|prefer|prefer to::更愿意做;prefer one to another::更喜欢前者|I prefer to read in a quiet room.::我更喜欢在安静的房间里阅读。|She prefers tea to coffee.::比起咖啡，她更喜欢茶。

preference|/ˈprefrəns/|n.|偏好；优先选择|基础|prefer|a preference for::对……的偏好;personal preference::个人偏好|He has a preference for simple designs.::他偏好简单的设计。|The choice depends partly on personal preference.::这个选择部分取决于个人偏好。
plan|/plæn/|n.; v.|计划；方案；打算|基础|action-planning|make a plan::制定计划;plan ahead::提前规划|We made a plan for the weekend trip.::我们为周末旅行制定了计划。|Try to plan ahead when the schedule is busy.::日程繁忙时，尽量提前规划。
prepare|/prɪˈper/|v.|准备；预备|基础|prepare|prepare for::为……作准备;prepare a meal::准备饭菜|The team is preparing for the next stage.::团队正在为下一阶段作准备。|We prepared a simple meal for the guests.::我们为客人准备了简单的饭菜。

preparation|/ˌprepəˈreɪʃən/|n.|准备；准备工作|基础|prepare|in preparation for::为……作准备;careful preparation::认真准备|Careful preparation made the presentation much easier.::认真准备使这次展示容易多了。|The hall was cleaned in preparation for the event.::为了准备活动，礼堂被打扫干净了。
expect|/ɪkˈspekt/|v.|预料；期待；要求|基础|expect|expect to::预计做;expect someone to::期待某人做|We expect to finish the repairs tomorrow.::我们预计明天完成维修。|The teacher expects every student to participate.::老师希望每位学生都参与。

expectation|/ˌekspekˈteɪʃən/|n.|预期；期待；期望|基础|expect|meet expectations::达到预期;in expectation of::期待着|The service did not meet our expectations.::这项服务没有达到我们的预期。|Clear instructions help set realistic expectations.::清晰的说明有助于建立合理的预期。

achieve|/əˈtʃiːv/|v.|实现；取得；达到|基础|achieve|achieve a goal::实现目标;achieve success::取得成功|Small steps can help us achieve a larger goal.::小步骤可以帮助我们实现更大的目标。|The team achieved better results after changing its method.::改变方法后，团队取得了更好的结果。

achievement|/əˈtʃiːvmənt/|n.|成就；成绩；完成|基础|achieve|a major achievement::重大成就;a sense of achievement::成就感|Finishing the project gave her a sense of achievement.::完成这个项目让她有了成就感。|The museum celebrates achievements in science and engineering.::博物馆展示并赞颂科学与工程的成就。

succeed|/səkˈsiːd/|v.|成功；接替；继承|基础|succeed|succeed in::成功做到;succeed someone as::接替某人担任|They succeeded in finding a simpler solution.::他们成功找到了更简单的解决办法。|She will succeed him as head of the team.::她将接替他担任团队负责人。

success|/səkˈses/|n.|成功；成功的人或事|基础|succeed|achieve success::取得成功;a great success::巨大的成功|The first public event was a great success.::首次公开活动非常成功。|Success often depends on patient, repeated work.::成功往往取决于耐心而反复的努力。

successful|/səkˈsesfəl/|adj.|成功的；有成效的|基础|succeed|a successful project::成功的项目;successful in::在……方面成功|The project was successful in reducing waste.::这个项目成功减少了浪费。|A successful discussion needs careful listening.::有成效的讨论需要认真倾听。
fail|/feɪl/|v.|失败；未能；失灵|基础|fail|fail to::未能做;fail a test::考试不及格|The old machine failed during the experiment.::旧机器在实验过程中发生了故障。|We failed to notice the small change.::我们未能注意到这个细微变化。

failure|/ˈfeɪljər/|n.|失败；故障；未履行|基础|fail|a power failure::停电;learn from failure::从失败中学习|A power failure interrupted the meeting.::停电打断了会议。|The team tried to learn from its first failure.::团队试图从第一次失败中吸取经验。

attempt|/əˈtempt/|n.; v.|尝试；企图|基础|action-effort|make an attempt::作出尝试;an attempt to::为做……的尝试|She made an attempt to explain the difference.::她尝试解释其中的差别。|We will attempt to repeat the experiment.::我们将尝试重复这项实验。

effort|/ˈefərt/|n.|努力；费力的事|基础|action-effort|make an effort::努力;with little effort::不费力地|Everyone made an effort to finish on time.::每个人都努力按时完成。|The tool lets us move heavy boxes with little effort.::这个工具让我们能轻松移动重箱子。

persist|/pərˈsɪst/|v.|坚持；持续存在|四级|persist|persist in::坚持做;problems persist::问题持续存在|She persisted in asking how the system worked.::她坚持追问这个系统如何运作。|Some problems persisted after the first repair.::首次维修后，一些问题仍然存在。

persistence|/pərˈsɪstəns/|n.|坚持；持续存在|六级|persist|patience and persistence::耐心与坚持;the persistence of::……的持续存在|The task required patience and persistence.::这项任务需要耐心与坚持。|The persistence of the problem surprised the team.::问题持续存在让团队感到意外。

determine|/dɪˈtɜːrmɪn/|v.|确定；决定；查明|基础|determine|determine the cause::查明原因;determine whether::确定是否|The team tried to determine the cause of the error.::团队试图查明错误的原因。|Further tests will determine whether the method works.::进一步测试将确定这种方法是否有效。

determination|/dɪˌtɜːrmɪˈneɪʃən/|n.|决心；确定；判定|基础|determine|show determination::表现出决心;the determination of::对……的确定|Her determination helped her continue after several failures.::她的决心帮助她在几次失败后继续前进。|The report explains the determination of the final cost.::报告解释了最终费用如何确定。

resolve|/rɪˈzɑːlv/|v.; n.|解决；决心；决意|四级|resolve|resolve a problem::解决问题;resolve to::决心做|We need to resolve the problem before Friday.::我们需要在周五前解决问题。|They resolved to improve communication within the team.::他们决心改善团队内部的沟通。

resolution|/ˌrezəˈluːʃən/|n.|解决；决议；决心；分辨率|四级|resolve|a peaceful resolution::和平解决;image resolution::图像分辨率|The two groups worked toward a peaceful resolution.::这两个群体努力寻求和平解决。|Higher image resolution can reveal smaller details.::更高的图像分辨率可以显示更细小的细节。

negotiate|/nɪˈɡoʊʃieɪt/|v.|谈判；协商；顺利通过|基础|negotiate|negotiate with::与……谈判;negotiate an agreement::协商达成协议|The two sides will negotiate a new agreement.::双方将协商一项新协议。|The driver carefully negotiated the narrow bend.::司机小心地驶过狭窄的弯道。

negotiation|/nɪˌɡoʊʃiˈeɪʃən/|n.|谈判；协商|六级|negotiate|through negotiation::通过协商;negotiation between::……之间的谈判|The issue was settled through negotiation.::这个问题通过协商得到了解决。|Negotiations between the two groups continued for weeks.::两个群体之间的谈判持续了几周。

compromise|/ˈkɑːmprəmaɪz/|n.; v.|妥协；折中；损害|基础|action-planning|reach a compromise::达成妥协;compromise safety::危及安全|Both sides were willing to reach a compromise.::双方都愿意达成妥协。|We cannot compromise safety to save a little time.::我们不能为节省一点时间而危及安全。

priority|/praɪˈɔːrəti/|n.|优先事项；优先权|四级|action-planning|a high priority::高度优先的事项;give priority to::优先考虑|Improving the water supply is a high priority.::改善供水是高度优先的事项。|The school gives priority to the needs of students.::学校优先考虑学生的需要。
